critical.issue: 422 Unprocessable Entity: {'loc':['body','invoice_number'],'msg':'Field required'}. models.Invoice declares invoice_number: str (required) while create_invoice() itself auto-generates it when falsy (`if not invoice.invoice_number: ...`). Frontend (InvoicesPage.handleCreateInvoice) never sends invoice_number, so EVERY invoice creation from the UI fails with toast 'Fatura kaydedilemedi.' Fix: make invoice_number Optional[str] = None (or default '') in models.Invoice.

minor.issue: Filter only checks show_in_b2b/is_active, so raw materials (prod_raw_01..03, type='raw_material', sale_price 0) and the junk product 'deneme' (SKU ddd, 0 stock, 0 price) are listed in the B2B dealer catalog with 0,00 ₺ prices. Consider excluding type in ('raw_material','service') and/or sale_price<=0.
No DELETE/cancel endpoint for a leave request; pending/approved leaves can never be removed via API (had to clean test rows directly in Mongo).
clean_doc keeps `_id` alongside `id` in every response, so raw Mongo _id is exposed in all payloads (harmless string UUIDs today, but violates the exclude-_id convention and doubles payload keys).

rca_of_the_issue: Invoice creation 422: Pydantic model Invoice inherits BaseDocument and declares `invoice_number: str` without default, so FastAPI rejects the request body before create_invoice() can run its own auto-numbering branch (`if not invoice.invoice_number`). Reproduce: curl -X POST /api/invoices with a valid body omitting invoice_number -> 422 'Field required'. Same request with invoice_number supplied returns 200. Mitigation: declare invoice_number as Optional[str] = None (auto-numbering already handles the empty case); frontend should also display err.response.data.detail.
